observations: The typed predicate rejects only tagged Balance actions when both Eclipse auras 48517 and 48518 are absent and POWER_ECLIPSE is zero, returning balance_neutral_opener.
The predicate uses existing HasMechanicTag, HasAura, GetPower and POWER_ECLIPSE APIs through the normal candidate path; native spell legality and fallback candidates remain intact.
The SQL update is limited to class 11, balance_druid, DPS, spell 78674 and is idempotent through FIND_IN_SET plus CONCAT_WS.
The patch is policy-only and player-like: it observes state and rejects a candidate without mutating Eclipse power, forcing a cast, changing coefficients, or touching encounter logic.
The source-shape test is appropriately scoped but does not execute the candidate builder; native candidate observation and exact validation remain required before repair acceptance.
